scope: E23A all144 frozen events initial Risk only; Q64/Page64/R4/rank8, M16 scoring, unchanged summary/Risk/Medium one swap. No raw KV access, new training, regrouping or new permanent per-page storage.
R2: fixed adjacent representative pairs(0,1),(2,3); arithmetic mean K and decoded V per pair, token mass32. R2 logits are pairwise means of EXISTING R4 logits; not another QK scan. Not mass-averaging R4 exponentials (which would reproduce R4 Z). No pair search.
proxy: deltaN=N4-N2,deltaZ=Z4-Z2 in common all-R4-Z scale; assume Raw extrapolation=2R4-R2, factor1 frozen, no fitted sign/scale. e_on=deltaN-O4all*deltaZ. EstimatedDense=O4all+sum(e_on)/(1+sum(deltaZ)); net proxy=e_on-(estimatedDense-O4all)*deltaZ so approximate mixed objective is internally consistent. Online-centered e_on is not mathematically exact Dense-centered residual.
methods: primary dual_rank8 projected onto orthonormal current per-head basis, full128 dual_full capacity/cost diagnostic; baseline existing FullV centered contribution projected rank8, d=0 (value_rank8). Each Set and Independent same information, same Medium one-action/no-op. Independent mean squared net page residual divided by estimatedDenseZ^2, score add-remove.
splits: 36city101 train descriptive;36city303 validation decision;72horse evaluation frozen, no selection. No fitting in A. Run train/validation first, lock stageB decision before horse.
gate: Primary dual_rank8 Set: validation mean true relative improvement>0 and degradation<=15%, AND greater mean improvement than same-information Independent and existing value_rank8 Set. If fails B not run. If passes B limited raw-snapshot feasibility, no claim144 can retrain summaries withoutrawKV. Full128 diagnostic cannot override gate.
metrics: Q64 real NMSE vs unchanged old Risk, signed e_on correlation/NMSE, net residual cosine, I sign/B error matched16, swap ranking/regret, cost accounting. Teachers evaluation only.
